facts.text: Serve the mains when Frank turns down the free meal at the deli.
facts.why: In the diner scene Peluce says the roast beef lunch is free and Frank asks to pay for it, he does not walk away from the meal. The lunch is a roast beef roll.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Frank asks to pay for the free roast beef lunch.

facts.text: the box on the squad room desk that Frank won't take for free
facts.why: No doughnut scene in the transcript. The free food shown is the roast beef lunch Frank asks to pay for. Note changed to match.
facts.fix: the squad room treat that Frank would pay for, not take free

facts.text: the free lunch Frank insists on paying for
facts.why: The free lunch in the film is a roast beef roll, not pastrami, though Frank does ask to pay for it. Note reworded to stay true.
facts.fix: the deli lunch Frank would rather pay for

facts.text: Our store on West 10th, a few doors from the Sixth Precinct.
facts.why: Nothing in the transcript names the Sixth Precinct. Frank lived in Greenwich Village, so the line now says that.
facts.fix: Our store on West 10th, in the Village where Frank lived.

vibe.verdict: A believable Village deli that gets the free food idea, the dog and the opera, but skips the shooting and the inquiry.
